summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The KraneShares 2x Long JD Daily ETF (KJD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer discretionary equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, net fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of JD.com, Inc. Sponsored ADR Class A (NASDAQ: JD), through direct investments and derivatives. KJD was launched on Oct 14, 2025 and is issued by KraneShares.

data.title: KraneShares Expands Single-Stock Levered ETF Suite With 2X Investment Exposure to JD.com (KJD)
